label: Zillow Scraper
title: Zillow Scraper: For Sale, Rent & Sold Listings
metaDescription: Scrape Zillow by location or search URL, for sale, for rent or sold: price, address, beds, baths, size, Zestimate, tax value, agent and photos.
intro: Search Zillow by location or paste a search link (for sale, for rent or recently sold) and get price, address, beds, baths, size, Zestimate, tax value, agent and every photo. Large areas are split automatically.
useCases: Pull sold comps for a valuation
Find rentals and their prices in a ZIP code
Track new for-sale listings in a market

faq.q: Does Zillow have a public API?
faq.a: Not any more. Zillow retired its public APIs (including the Zestimate API) in 2021, and its Bridge feeds are limited to approved partners. This actor reads Zillow's search results instead.

faq.q: How do I scrape Zillow listings without code?
faq.a: Type a city, ZIP or neighbourhood, or paste a Zillow search link with your filters, choose for sale, for rent or sold, and press Start. Results come as JSON, CSV or Excel.

faq.q: Can I get sold homes and rentals?
faq.a: Yes. Pick for sale, for rent or recently sold; each listing has price, address, beds, baths, size, Zestimate, tax value, days on Zillow and photos.

faq.q: Why does Zillow stop at about 800 results?
faq.a: Zillow serves roughly 800 listings per search. With "Split large areas" on, the actor divides a big area into smaller ones and searches each, so it reaches listings that paging alone cannot.

faq.q: Can I use it as a Zillow API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input works in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.

liveDemo.label: Zillow search link
liveDemo.hint: Paste a Zillow search link (a city, ZIP or map search) and press Run: the demo fetches the first listings live (up to 10).

officialApi: Zillow retired its public APIs in 2021; its data feeds (Bridge Interactive) are only for approved real-estate partners. This actor returns what Zillow shows on its search pages for a location or a search link.
